# @tansy/seo

Search-engine fields and a sitemap for tansy, built from each collection's URL pattern.

```bash
npm install @tansy/seo
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the seo plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/seo.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
